summary: Under normal market conditions, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets in common stocks and other equity-type securities of small and mid-capitalization companies in the United States. The investment adviser currently defines “small and mid-capitalization companies” to be companies whose market capitalizations typically fall within the range of the Russell 2500 Index or the Russell Midcap Index. The fund is non-diversified.
